concept.title: Notices
concept.shortdesc: What's real and what's invented in this documentation set.

conbody.p: This documentation set is an unofficial, independent sample project built to demonstrate DITA content-reuse and taxonomy techniques. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any of the organizations behind the real product named below.

OBS Studio is a real, free and open-source software project. Its name and general feature set are used here factually, but this documentation is an independent sample, not the official OBS Studio manual.

The following four products—StreamForge Capture, StreamForge Cloud, StreamForge Mobile, and StreamForge Studio Pro—along with the umbrella name StreamForge Creator Suite, are entirely fictional. They were invented for this exercise to provide realistic multi-product scenarios for content reuse, taxonomy, and key-scoped map architecture. No such products exist.
